faqs.question: What session length options are available for the Pampering Package at Bella Lucy Spa?
faqs.answer: The Pampering Package at Bella Lucy Spa is available in two options: a 60-minute Upper Body Massage combined with a Signature Facial, or a 90-minute Upper Body Massage combined with a Signature Facial. Both options include the same two treatments, with the difference being the duration of the massage session.

faqs.question: What treatments are included in the Pampering Package at Bella Lucy Spa?
faqs.answer: Each version of the Pampering Package includes an Upper Body Massage and a Signature Facial. These two treatments are combined into a single spa session regardless of which duration option is chosen.

faqs.question: Where is Bella Lucy Spa located?
faqs.answer: Bella Lucy Spa is located at 500 Sun Valley Drive in Milton, GA 30004. This is the designated redemption location for the Pampering Package.

faqs.question: What type of spa is Bella Lucy Spa categorized as?
faqs.answer: Bella Lucy Spa is classified as a Day Spa, falling under the broader Beauty & Spas and Spas categories. Day spas typically offer single-visit treatments without overnight accommodations.

faqs.question: How much longer is the massage in the 90-minute Pampering Package compared to the 60-minute option?
faqs.answer: The 90-minute Pampering Package at Bella Lucy Spa provides 30 additional minutes of Upper Body Massage time compared to the 60-minute option. Both packages also include a Signature Facial as part of the experience.
